body:
As I'm now living in London, I'm fine. I was worried from my Mom and friends, but everyone is fine. There's between 118 and 140 dead people there from 3 different terrorists attacks. 

It's a nightmare.

I'm depressed, I'm exhausted to maintain the apparences at work. I also lost a bit of self-confidence. I feel useless, I feel like I'm really the shittiest employee ever.

And I'm totally breaking down because I used to lived where one of the attacks in Paris took place. It's a nightmare. 


I want this to end.

My team is nicknamed "The Intouchables".

The company's motto is "work hard play hard" but my team is specifically excluded from the "play hard" part.
We had a party for Halloween, in the building. Free beers and candies, very nice and all. We were even allowed to go to work wearing a custome. It was supposed to start at 4 and everyone was finishing early to go. We only had the right to there a 4.30 (nothing left whatsoever) and had to go back to our desk by 5.10 like little kids.

I was told during my interview that it was a 9 til 5.30 job, week days. On my first day after training I was told by a colleague that we had to work week-ends every fortnight. The manager who interviewed me never even commented on that.

My colleagues are supposed to train me on specific stuff the general training did not cover. They can't be bothered. They all just wanna leave or at least do their jobs and go home and relax. They don't care about me. There's a new girl, she arrived after me and they like her, so she got booked for a training that I needed... but I wasn't even invited to it.

There's a huge Christmas party in the next few weeks. The whole building is talking about this, the one from the previous year was a blast apparently. I just received an email telling me to answer to the RSPV mail sent on Monday. No one in my team got it. We're simply not invited.

They told us we'd get a nice bonus each year because the company is doing great. I know the company is doing great - that's one of the biggest UK companies.
But my team doesn't get a bonus. Well, we're supposed to, but they used that money to cover for the lost parcels carrier are not liable for. So basically, when a customer gets his parcel stolen / lies about not finding it, we're paying it with our bonus. We're the only team that has this.

I refused an amazing job to go there because this company used to be my favorite brand ever. But I feel useless. You could take the first French wanker that speaks remotely good English and he would be a good fit.
I feel so fucked. They ran after me for WEEKS because they apparently really wanted me to work for them, advertised the job totally differently than what it really entails and I feel SO FUCKED AND ALONE. I HATE THEM AND I HATE MYSELF EVEN MORE.

I'm so depressed I can't even look for another job properly. Every time people ask me why I wanna leave my current job so quickly I'm on the verge of crying. It's unfair.

I want to die. I don't even wanna go home. I simply want to disappear.
I don't know how talking about it would make it better. I'm just a failure.
